newsitem.title: UK: NWE GASOLINE UP $1-2 ON BACK OF API DRAW.
newsitem.headline: NWE GASOLINE UP $1-2 ON BACK OF API DRAW.

text.p: NWE physical gasoline was $1-2 a tonne firmer on Wednesday on the back of a draw in U.S. stocks and renewed U.S. buying interest.
Paper gasoline rose by as much as $3.00 a tonne for balance of August.
Dealers said eurograde barges were sold at $219.00, $220.00 and $218.50 fob AR for second half August material.
Swaps for the balance of August rose by $3.00 to $214.00. September and October were higher, but less so with September around $197.25 and October at $189.00.
Tight supplies in the Mediterranean and little significant fresh supplies in NWE much before August 20 give underlying support.
